title: Doubles/Halves Mastery Check
objective: Determine whether doubles, near-doubles, honest halving, and two-digit doubling are secure enough to move into Unit 3.2.

tasks.prompt: State 4 of 5 doubles facts 1-10 from memory.
Solve one near-double-plus-one and one near-double-minus-one problem, choosing the correct direction for each.
State half of an even number using its doubles fact, and correctly identify that an odd number does not split evenly, naming the leftover.
Double a two-digit number by doubling tens and ones separately.

mastery.reteachTrigger: Applies the same near-double direction (+1 or -1) regardless of the actual problem (reteach 3.1.3/3.1.4 side by side) or forces an odd number into two "equal" unequal groups without naming a leftover (reteach 3.1.6).
